title: Beach Bliss | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Located in a gated, Gulf front community with beach access directly across from the home, Beach Bliss is a great home for anyone looking for a relaxing getaway!
description_expanded: Description: Beach Bliss by Royal Destinations Location: Blue Mountain Beach Address: 248 Old Beach Road, Santa Rosa Beach, FL Details: Located in 30A’s Gulf-front community of Old Florida Beach, Beach Bliss offers close proximity to the beach access as well as a large community pool mere steps away. With an abundance of activities to choose from all within walking distance of the home, guests of this Blue Mountain Beach rental can take full advantage of the beach or kayak, paddleboard, and fish at Draper Lake, one of the area's rare coastal dune lakes. This 30A luxury vacation rental features an open concept kitchen, living, and dining area and sophisticated style coupled with a seaside lifestyle that shows through the interior design. Whether you’re planning to travel with your extended family or friends, guests can enjoy 6 bedrooms and a carriage house complete with a fully equipped kitchen. Don’t wait to reserve your 30A getaway at Beach Bliss today! If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: - 1 Minute Walk To The Beach Access, Community Pool, and Draper Lake - Lake Access Across the Street - Gulf Front Gated Community - Large Community Pool - Carriage House With King Bed And Private Bath - Parking Spaces: 4 in Driveway - 6 Adult Bikes Included - Coffee Maker Included - Propane Grill - High-Speed Wireless Internet - Clean Linen Program -1 Beach Service Set* *Seasonal: March – October Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 14 6 Beds / 5.5 Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1 (King En Suite): King Bed with Private Bath -Half Bath -Living room -Kitchen -Laundry Room Second Floor: -Bedroom 2 (King En Suite): King Bed with Private Bath -Bedroom 3 (King En Suite): King Bed with Private Bath -Bedroom 4: Two Twins with Shared Bath -Bedroom 5: Two Twin/Twin Bunk Beds with Shared Bath Carriage House: -Bedroom 6 (King En-Suite): King Bed with Private Bath -Kitchen Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
